scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a store front with a counter and chairs inside. The store has a wooden counter and brown leather chairs. There are two computer monitors on the counter. There are pictures and other items on display. The ceiling is black and there are lights on it. The floor is made of wood. There are windows on the left side of the store. The walls are made of wood and have posters on them. The overall atmosphere is bright and clean.
